newsitem.title: HUNGARY: OTP hits high, benefits from K&H sale.
newsitem.headline: OTP hits high, benefits from K&H sale.

text.p: Shares in OTP Bank leapt to a new record high of 6,600 forints before slipping back on Thursday, benefiting from the privatisation of K&H Bank, a trader said.
"OTP's price reflects the sale price of K&H Bank on Wednesday," he said.
At 1044 GMT OTP traded at 6,515 forints, up 265.

Hungary's privatisation agency APV Rt said on Wednesday it would sell a stake in Kereskedelmi Bank (K&H) to a consortium of Belgium's Kredietbank and Ireland's Irish Life Plc for $30 million, which represents 567.3 percent of the face value.
This is a record price for a Hungarian bank privatisation.
